August 4, 2026

Registered voters are more likely to say they'll vote for Democrats than Republicans in this fall's congressional elections by a margin of 4 percentage points, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's in line with the consistent single-digit leads for Democrats — usually low single digits — that Economist / YouGov surveys have found among registered voters over the past year. [...] Among registered voters in districts with Democratic members of the House, incumbents over the past three weeks of Economist / YouGov polling have positive net favorability in both safe districts (45% very or somewhat favorable and 27% unfavorable, for a net of +18) and swing distric
results.title: Registered voters in swing districts prefer Democrats to Republicans for Congress
